title: Контакти та зустрічі
fields_and_relations: Мінімальна контактна підказка, теми, зустріч, рекомендація, retention.
required_interaction: Запланувати/відмова/зв’язати з підтвердженою person; чужий контакт недоступний.

implementation.view_model: WF-02: scoped contact/search, group/place, working notes, referrals with cycle checks, meetings/reschedule/refusal/unreachable, retention review, explicit person/location confirmation and atomic session handoff
limitations: Local browser prototype; retention uses fixture clock; clear deletes communication details, working notes and incoming recommendations, not historical identity hints. No shared backend, notifications or automatic respondent discovery.
implementation.state_storage: Shared normalized browser store; fixture version 9
implementation.atomicity: Authorize, expected revision, clone, validate, hash, commit. No partial mutation on failure.
